To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new nano-sized Pb2+-imprinted polymer was successfully prepared and its application as a chemical interface of an electrode for determination of toxic Pb2+ in different real samples was demonstrated for the first time.
the IIP modified carbon paste electrode showed a considerably high response to Pb(2+), compared to the electrode with NIP.
the IIP nanoparticles were synthesized by a facile method and used as a modifier for fabrication of Pb(2+)-sensitive electrode.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of a new nano-ionic imprinted polymer, as a selective recognition element, for the fabrication of an electrochemical Pb(2+) sensor.
the development of a novel, sensitive and selective sensor based on the IIP-nanocomposite for determination of trace lead in real samples.
the development of a simple, sensitive and selective method for determination of trace Pb(2+) in real samples, based on the use of a new nano-sized IIP.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present method can be considered as a simple, sensitive, and selective technique for the trace determination of lead in different real samples.
the IIP-nanocomposite modified carbon paste electrode was a simple and efficient tool for determination of Pb(2+), with high selectivity and sensitivity.
this work is a successful attempt to prepare and use a new Pb2+ imprinter polymer with a nano-structured morphology, which can be used for the fabrication of a new electrochemical sensor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new nano-sized ion imprinted polymer was prepared for the first time.
the IIP-nanocomposite electrode is a promising candidate for the determination of lead in real samples.
the proposed IIP sensor could be used for determination of lead at low concentration level and it could be applied as a new tool for the analysis of real samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the IIP modified electrode is a promising sensing tool for trace lead determination in real samples.
the IIP modified electrode can be used as the chemical interface in the fabrication of electrochemical sensors.
the nano-sized IIP is an effective and efficient tool to fabricate a new electrochemical sensor with high selectivity, sensitivity, and stability.
